description: FEBCIC crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/n. Reported CIF formula moiety: C94 H110 N1 O13 Si8 Sm3,C4 H8 O1,x(C6 H14). From the CIF bond table, Sm1 (Sm) has 4 O neighbors; Sm2 (Sm) has 6 O neighbors; Sm3 (Sm) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with approximately linear metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.460-3.474 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 88.99-91.82°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Sm3{(Ph2SiO)2O}3{N(SiMe3)2}(THF)4]. Article name explicitly identifies I(I), I(II).
